stages.name: Stage 1 — Story (first pass)
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
stages.summary: Play through all five chapters of the campaign, which takes roughly 60–80 hours and hands you the chapter and named-mission trophies automatically as you go. Take optional missions as they appear, scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through the binoculars whenever you spot them, since all of that progress counts later. The one thing to secure before moving on is Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1, just after Down to Earth — it is the list's only potentially missable item — and, because there is no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter as insurance.

stages.name: Stage 2 — 100% Completion checklist
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
stages.summary: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work through the checklist, the longest stretch of the run at around 100 hours. Prioritise the categories that must be finished in full — every robbery, the underwater discoveries, gold medals in all 42 shooting range challenges, a win at all 14 drone race locations and Bret's Target Decks — alongside 250-plus stunts, 200 vehicle scans and 70 of the 80 challenges. Most activity trophies, from Master of None to One Last Thing, pop on their own during this stage.

stages.name: Stage 3 — Collectibles & exploration
stages.summary: Knock out the collection-style trophies that the checklist only partially covers. Complete any 3 collectible card sets (the checklist wants 15 of 18, so keep going if you are close), scan 100 WAiNK locations among the landmarks, curiosities and sculptures, and unfog all 52 areas of Leonida — a plane makes the map sweep fast. None of this is missable, so it can be done at whatever pace suits you.

stages.name: Stage 4 — Strangers, freaks & questlines
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
stages.summary: Finish the named character questlines and the stranger strands. Work through Andy's line as Lucia, Kenton's seven shipwrecks, Billy's mud-club jobs, Randy's 16-car wish list and Tyrone's lab takedowns as Jason, plus Bret's hunting Target Decks and Cal's fishing challenge, and complete any eight qualifying stranger strands for the Strangers & Freaks silver. Every one of these quest givers is still available in post-story free-roam, so nothing in this stage can be missed.

stages.name: Stage 5 — Crime, cash & misc cleanup
stages.summary: Sweep up the free-roam feats that are left: the partner wanted-level trophies, five bank vault robberies and an armored truck, one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs, the showroom Banshee escape, the Kingpin Bowling valuables, the stolen VCIA jet and the Rhino tank, and the Kelly County UFO encounter. Then close the money targets — $250,000 of marked bills laundered, $100,000 spent in shops, all eight garages bought and ten vehicles registered to Scooter Bros — and make sure the 500 Criminal Profile actions are done. By the end of this stage every non-platinum trophy should be earned.

stages.name: Platinum
stages.summary: Once the other 54 trophies are in, Vice Got a Price! unlocks automatically — there is no separate task for it. If anything is still missing, the trophy list's built-in trackers and the 100% checklist will show exactly which counter is short. Congratulations, you're a Leonida Legend.
